products.title: Vanilla Bean Basque Cheesecake
products.body_html:
Our Basque Vanilla Bean Cheesecake is the perfect harmony of rustic charm and refined flavor. Baked at a high temperature to achieve its signature caramelized top, this cheesecake captures the essence of contrast with a golden, slightly burnt exterior that gives way to a silky, creamy center. Every bite melts effortlessly, revealing the warmth of real Madagascar vanilla beans, known for their aromatic depth and natural sweetness that lingers delicately on the palate.

Our Basque Vanilla Bean Cheesecake is the perfect mix of rustic charm and refined flavor. Baked at high heat to create its signature caramelized top, it strikes a beautiful balance between textures — a golden, slightly burnt crust on the outside and a soft, creamy center within.

Each bite melts effortlessly, filled with the warmth of real Madagascar vanilla beans that add a rich aroma and delicate sweetness. The flavor is comforting yet sophisticated, making it as inviting as it is indulgent.

Unlike a traditional cheesecake, the Basque style celebrates imperfection. Its uneven edges, toasted surface, and irresistible aroma make it feel cozy, homemade, and still undeniably luxurious. It’s a dessert that looks simple but tastes refined, turning even an ordinary moment into something special.

Enjoy it on its own or pair it with espresso, fresh berries, or a drizzle of caramel. Serve slightly chilled for elegant, clean slices.
